steps.title: Clinic details
steps.description: Name, logo, contact and the currency you'll charge in.

steps.title: Branches
steps.description: At least one branch with its address. If you see patients in a single place, it's just one.

steps.title: Office hours
steps.description: The days and hours the branch is open. The calendar and the patient portal don't offer appointments outside these hours.

steps.title: Rooms
steps.description: Each room or chair is its own calendar within a branch.

steps.title: Doctors
steps.description: The physicians or dentists who see patients. Each one has their own user to sign in to Invoke.

steps.title: Each doctor's availability
steps.description: Which days and at what hours each doctor sees patients. Without availability no gaps show up for booking.

steps.title: Services
steps.description: The catalog of treatments with their price and duration. The duration sets the appointment length.

steps.title: Test appointment
steps.description: Book a test appointment to see everything working together. With this the minimum is done!

steps.title: Administrative team
steps.description: Front desk and administration, each with their role.

steps.title: Payment methods
steps.description: Cash, cards, transfer: what's chosen when charging.

steps.title: WhatsApp
steps.description: Connect the WhatsApp agent to confirm appointments and reply to patients.

steps.title: Import patients
steps.description: Bring your patients in from a spreadsheet so you don't enter them one by one.
